platform: DGX Spark, Ubuntu ARM64, GNOME X11
methods: Production make desktop ARM64 build launched in the real user desktop session.
GTK controls and native file choosers exercised through AT-SPI; real X11 keyboard events used for picker locations and window shortcuts.
Tray reopening exercised through its published StatusNotifier DBusMenu action interface.
Fresh disposable folders, private CA and two mutual-TLS identities, loopback peers, mDNS disabled, explicit independent state directories.
Existing service/preferences were absent at baseline. Only test-owned integration and processes were removed; the preexisting desktop lock was preserved.
Status inspection used atomic status.json files and systemd user service state; no UI access to the daemon database.
Transfers first exercised configured batching; preview transfers used unlimited transfer quantum and a 512 KiB/s outgoing limit to permit observation of sustained activity.
A malformed test transfer-quantum value was rejected at Start with a visible error and no running daemon; correcting the test configuration allowed recovery.
A test-owned daemon was temporarily suspended with SIGSTOP to exercise stale heartbeat detection, then resumed with SIGCONT.

cleanup: Confirmed service removal through Settings. Tray and both test daemons stopped; test login integration and selected preferences removed. Test-created profiles and histories retained in a private temporary archive, outside active user configuration.
limitations: Interactive captures use the real desktop dark appearance; light/dark GTK rendering is additionally covered by automated widget tests.
Wayland, actual logout/login, graphical DEB installation, clean-machine prompts, and physical cross-machine LAN behavior were not tested in this run.
Mac native UI checks for the original Mac changes are documented separately; the shared Go extraction in this continuation has not been rerun on a Mac.
Hosted CI on the preceding commit was rejected before any runner started due to an account payment/spending-limit annotation. Fresh-commit CI must pass before merge; local results do not replace it.
